Top risk themes are **privacy concerns (−40)**, **data-privacy concerns (−18)**, **accuracy issues (−17)** and **hallucinations (−16)** — all trust-and-reliability narratives, not feature gaps.
Where we win is utility, not trust: positives cluster on **24/7 availability (+16)**, **infinite patience (+9)** and **productivity boost (+7)** — themes to amplify.
